title: attractor cycler · lorenz / aizawa / thomas / halvorsen
input: pointer (click to cycle stage, drag-to-orbit not exposed but auto camera reveals 3D)

scene_features.volumetric_beam: Cone(r=1.2, h=11) with custom translucent additive shader, off-center upper-left, slight tilt; particles intersecting the beam get +50% brightness boost
scene_features.transition: 1.4s smooth blend between modes (both equations integrated and lerped during transition, plus palette lerp)

notes: Click to cycle through 4 famous strange attractors on the same 100k-particle GPGPU buffer. Smooth equation-blending during transitions (not a re-spawn) means particles flow continuously through the design space — Lorenz orbit gradually deforms into the Aizawa vortex, the Aizawa vortex unwraps into the Thomas alien lattice, etc. Fog gives depth; one volumetric light cone cuts diagonally across the scene and brightens particles passing through it.
